priorityList: Use Potions and offensive Trinkets during Metamorphosis for maximum burst alignment.
Cast Metamorphosis on cooldown, ideally when the Eradicate buff is active.
Cast Pierce the Veil if the Moment of Craving buff is active and Collapsing Star is ready to be cast.
Cast Voidblade if you are at maximum Void Metamorphosis stacks and have the Devourer's Bite talent.
Cast The Hunt if you are at maximum Void Metamorphosis stacks or during Metamorphosis if Voidsurge is not talented.
Cast Void Ray as your primary spender to maintain the Eradicate buff in single target.
Cast Voidblade if the Moment of Craving buff is active and you are approaching maximum Collapsing Star stacks.
Cast Collapsing Star on cooldown, prioritizing windows where Predators Wake and Voidblade are on cooldown.
Execute the Reap sequence (Eradicate > Cull > Reap) if you have 4 or more souls during Metamorphosis or if a Voidfall proc is active.
Cast Vengeful Retreat if the Voidstep buff is active.
Cast Reapers Toll if the Voidsurge: Reapers Toll buff is active.
Cast Pierce the Veil if the Voidsurge: Pierce the Veil buff is active or if talented into Duty Eternal for single target.
Cast Voidblade as a generator if talented into Duty Eternal in single target.
Cast Devour and Consume as low-priority filler to generate resources.
